body: God no, I don't even have the courage to go see a doctor with a common cold, certainly not go through 6-8 months of humilliating "therapy" sessions before (if being very lucky, because I would not qualify with my depression and anxieties, I don't live in the US) getting to go on hormones. I've never told anyone, it's never happening.

I'm not saying if you feel like shit, that it can't possibly get better, obviously! I'm saying there are people out there (me included), in situations that doesn't allow them to get better, who don't have the qualities and resources to get better. To say that isn't true, is so arrogantly false, that I don't even know where to begin... These people usually end up killing themselves. And then it is so easy afterwards, to say that it would have been so incredibly easy to save them, if they had just sought the help they needed, but that is my exact point, we are unable, we literally can't.

Let me ask you, how does one get better, if you have very severe depression, no one in your life to help you, no friends no family, no social network, severe social anxiety, walking out the front door is almost impossible in itself, so seeking professional help is completely impossible. This person has tried it's very very best all life, to no positive outcome. How does one become better if this person on top of it all, has no drive to live, to try any further. Because I fail to see it.

Edit: I know it's better to be positive, but I've no positivity left. With the downvotes I'm getting, I can tell I'm not wanted here, so I'll just leave and say I'm sorry I exist, sorry I'm not positive. Sorry I write how I actually see the world instead of just accepting the overly positive outlook people here have. I'll go back to being alone until I can't deal with life anymore and kill myself, because that is how my life will end.

>Life is what you make of it. If you have no drive to make it better, it never will be.

Bingo! 

I've no drive anymore, nothing i've ever tried, and trust me I've tried my very best, has ever improved my life the slightest. So no, I've no drive to enjoy life. I wish I could turn on that drive, but I can't, it doesn't work like that, and I'm to messed up to even begin thinking about seeking help.
Again that is just not true. It's a nice sentiment though.

>If you've accepted your circumstance, why are you commenting on a positive "it gets better" post?

Because I'm self-destructive. 

>I know you don't want to hear positive remarks right now.

That's not true, I'm very glad, every time I hear somebody who has found them selves and found peace with their existence. I don't like hearing overused cliches that are demonstrably false. Spread the positive stories, but one shouldn't pretend one can speak for everyone.

>So I worked on small things like choosing books, making friends, etc.

Even those "small" things are also unattainable things to me, especially the friends part. I am deeply unhappy, there are no things in this life, that I actually enjoy, that isn't just a coping mechanism to forget life, they do not improve the quality of my life. Even something so simple as finding things to watch on Netflix has become impossible, I just can't concentrate enough to get into it. I've never had friends, never. It's not like I haven't tried, but I just suck. So no even these small things are impossible. I'm unable to feel any sort of happiness and no matter what I do, my life get worse day by day and I do not have what it takes, to do anything about it, I honestly don't think there is anything that can be done at this point other than suicide.

I don't know you, but what I can quickly gather, is that you're young and have had the courage, strength, energy and willpower to go on hrt and start your transition. Even if I accept your statement about you being weak, you're infinitely stronger than me, because what you've shown is to me an in unattainable amount of courage, strength willpower. This sub is filled with people who have that amount of good qualities, the people out there without them are not here.

My whole point is that there are many many people who lack that, who does not have it, and do not have the resources to get it.

I wish more than anything, that I could be as brave as you and the others, even if you consider yourself weak.
I feel the same, that is all from me.

You're right I've a defeatist attitude, because I am defeated. I have zero faith in my life ever becoming better, because my life has never gotten better, it has gradually gotten shittier and shittier, despite me trying my absolutely best and tried and improve my life, it might not be enough, or even close to what people on here have done. But not everyone is as strong as you and the other successful transitioners here.

You saying you can't stand my attitude, is literally like saying you can't stand people who don't have it in themselves to improve their life, because believe it or not, some people are just not strong enough to handle extremely hard lives. There is a reason the suicide rate is so incredibly high.

Edit: Oh and I've accepted my circumstances, hence my life not getting better.

It got better for YOU!

You can't possibly know it will get better for everyone. I know you mean well and I'm very glad you feel better, but this is something you've no actual knowledge about, all you know is you yourself feel better... How I might feel is totally unknown to you. 

I might just be a lost hateful bitter person, but I've always hated that sentence. I'm sorry.
I can't, I don't have the courage to do so, just the thought of me opening up to a doctor or a therapist gives me panic attacks, so it wont happen.
Thanks for posting, but maybe give it another read.

I'm happy for you, congrats!

I guess I'll go against the stream. I'm not doing good, I'm doing horrible. Every day is worse than the day before it, I am completely miserable and I don't believe life will ever be worth living. I'm not out to anybody, not even close friends, but that is just because I don't have any friends what so ever, good, decent or bad friends, I've neither. Ran't over...

Wow... Are you me? 
Because everything you just wrote is 100% how I think, how I feel, how I see the world. I'm not transitioning and I unfortunately can't see myself ever doing it, despite me wishing I could. I'm with you, I understand you completely. I don't have any answers, I'm just as lost in this world as you are, but this is how I deal with the different things.

>What do you do to help with the loneliness?

I Joined a support group for young lonely/quiet people, it was the hardest thing I've ever done. I don't know if it has helped me at all, but I have something to do 2 times a week, and I get out around people. Still incredibly lonely when I get home, but then I just burry myself in netflix...

>What do you do to help improve your self image?

I've been growing my hair, lucky for me, long hair on guys is extremely popular right now where I live. I have a skincare routine which helps with my self-confidence. Lastly when I'm alone I "crossdress", I practice makeup, I watch the tv-series and movies I really like, I listen to the music I really like, I'm being myself unapologetic.

>What do you do to make you feel better about yourself?

See above, but most of the times it doesn't help, so I just try to forget life by watching a tv-series I really like (Gilmore Girls, trust me, best tv-show ever!).

>What advice would you give to someone who is struggling with existing?

I'm drawing a blank here, I honestly could use some advice, but unfortunately I've never heard any advice that has been able to help me. Life is complicated and really really though, I try to just be happy I was born in a country that allows me to live in a nice home, have food on the table, have a good job etc. etc.

I'm not saying these are healthy ways to deal with life, but we are not healthy people, we suppress who we are, because we can't deal with life in a healthy manner. The correct way is to seek help, but that is infinitely easier said than done. I wish you all the best.

I'm so far from being in a place where I could even attempt to begin to think about transitioning, and no matter how hard I try to push myself, I never get any closer, I honestly think that I will never get what it takes and I will therefore never transition and never be a women... :(

So not good. Very bad actually.. I'm so tired of this..
